feed_title: Extra Large Orthopaedic Memory Foam Dog Bed 122 x 89cm, 18cm Deep, U Shaped Bolster, Waterproof Liner, Cover Opens Three Sides | PawLunova Melbreak
descriptionHtml:
122 × 89cm. Memory foam. A cover that opens along three sides.

Melbreak is an extra large orthopaedic memory foam bolster dog bed, 122 × 89 × 18cm, with a waterproof inner layer and a cover that opens on three sides.

You washed the last cover once. Then you spent half an hour stretching it back over the foam and gave up three-quarters on. A cover that fights you stops being washed.

This one opens along three sides, so the foam comes out flat and goes back flat.

What they get

  • A cover that opens on three sides: Off in one go, back on without a wrestle.
  • 122 × 89cm: Around 70% more floor area than a typical 90 × 70cm large bed.
  • Memory foam with an egg-crate profiled layer: 18cm of it, under a textured plush surface.
  • A U-shaped bolster, front left open: A back or a chin leans in, with nothing to step over.

Best for: big dogs who lean, and owners tired of fighting a cover on.

Why it is worth the money

£155 is a lot for a dog bed, so here is the arithmetic. Underneath the plush is memory foam rather than loose filling, with a waterproof inner layer above it and a 5-year no-flatten guarantee under it. Across the 1825 nights that guarantee covers, £155 is about 8p a night. You have 100 nights to watch what they do with it. If the answer is nothing, collection from the UK mainland is free and the refund full.

The waterproof layer is inside, not on the surface. The cover is plush rather than wipe-clean, so a muddy coat means a wash.

Melbreak or Staveley? Same footprint. Melbreak has the textured plush and the three-sided opening. Staveley has a short-plush cover and a non-skid base.

Size and fit

SizeExternal (cm)Suits
Extra Large122 × 89 × 18Big dogs who sleep pressed against an edge

Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. These are outside measurements and the bolster takes up some of that. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly whether it fits.

Everyday care

Open the cover, take it off and wash it to its sewn-in label. Air-dry fully before refitting. Never wash or soak the foam.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

100 nights to decide. 5 years on the foam.

Try it at home for 100 nights from delivery. If it is not right, we arrange free UK mainland collection and a full refund. One trial per household; damage and other exclusions apply. The foam core also has a 5-year no-flatten guarantee under normal domestic use, subject to the guarantee terms; cover wear and pet damage are not included. Read the full returns and guarantee terms. This guarantee is in addition to your statutory rights and does not affect them.

The questions we get asked most

Is 122cm big enough?

Measure side-on, add 15 to 20cm, and remember the bolster.

When does it turn up?

Free over £40. Your postcode window sits by the basket.

Can I pay in instalments?

Yes. Instalment options appear at checkout.

Where is the waterproof layer?

Between the plush cover and the foam.

Is it kind to older dogs?

No wall at the front. Past that, ask your vet.

Can I actually wash it?

That is the point of the three-sided opening.

What if they will not settle?

Say so inside 100 nights. It leaves free and refunded.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.

Take the cover off in one go and put it back in another.
